drafted_at_note: hand-written fictional held-out case; key written and committed before any model call, 2026-10-15

expected_items.title: Mandatory job code on every expense, synced from their project system
expected_items.body: Foremen type job names into notes and spell them differently. Rosa wants a mandatory job code picked from a list kept in sync with their project management system, which gets a few new codes a month.
expected_items.quote: We need a mandatory job code on every expense, picked from a list that stays in sync with our project management system.

expected_items.title: Harbor Street public works contract makes job-level reporting a payment risk from February
expected_items.body: A public works job starts in February and the city requires job-level cost reports for every expense or can hold back large progress payments. That sets a deadline on the job code ask.
expected_items.quote: the city requires job-level cost reports for every expense, or they can hold back our progress payments.

expected_items.title: Daniel takes job code sync to product this week
expected_items.body: Syncing the code list from their project system is not supported; Daniel will take it to product this week and come back with an answer.
expected_items.quote: I'll take the job code sync to our product team this week and come back with an answer.

expected_items.title: Rosa sends the current job code list tomorrow
expected_items.body: Rosa will send their current list of job codes the next day.
expected_items.quote: I'll send you our current job code list tomorrow

expected_items.title: Rosa introduces Marco, their IT lead who owns the project system
expected_items.body: In the same breath as the job code list, Rosa committed to introducing Daniel to Marco, who owns the project system the sync would read from.
expected_items.quote: I'll also introduce you to Marco, our IT lead, because he owns the project system.

expected_items.title: Daniel sets up a mandatory job code field with a fixed list as a stopgap
expected_items.body: Until a sync exists, Daniel will configure a mandatory custom job code field with a fixed list so the spelling problem goes away.
expected_items.quote: In the meantime I'll set up the job code field as mandatory with a fixed list, so at least the spelling problem goes away.

expected_items.title: Uploads on low-signal sites fail silently after showing submitted
expected_items.body: On sites with bad signal the app shows submitted but the receipt never arrives, with no error. Foremen then throw away the paper receipt; at least a dozen receipts were lost this month, some worth hundreds of dollars.
expected_items.quote: A foreman takes a photo of a receipt, the app says submitted, and then it never arrives.

expected_items.title: Daniel files the silent upload failure with engineering today as a priority bug
expected_items.body: Daniel committed to filing the lost uploads with engineering the same day as a priority bug.
expected_items.quote: I'll file it with engineering today as a priority bug.

expected_items.title: Felix sends a screen recording of a failed upload and each foreman's app version
expected_items.body: Felix will record his screen the next time an upload fails and send the video along with the app version from each foreman's phone.
expected_items.quote: I'll record my screen next time it happens and send you the video, plus the app version from each foreman's phone.

expected_items.title: Daniel adds the foremen to the offline upload beta this week
expected_items.body: An offline mode that queues uploads is in beta; Daniel will add Cobalt Ridge's foremen to it this week.
expected_items.quote: I'll add your foremen to the beta this week.

expected_items.title: Automatic mileage logging between sites from phone location
expected_items.body: Foremen drive between sites all day and log every trip by hand; they want the app to log site-to-site drives automatically from location.
expected_items.quote: They'd like the app to log the drive between two sites automatically from the phone's location.

expected_items.title: Daniel puts the foremen down for early access to GPS mileage
expected_items.body: GPS mileage tracking is on the roadmap; Daniel will register Cobalt Ridge's foremen as an early-access customer.
expected_items.quote: I'll put your foremen down as an early-access customer for it.
